ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Dyad id, used to match participant pairs
Beverage condition that the subject is assigned to
Feedback-related negativity (FRN) extracted from a time-estimation task as the player
Feedback-related negativity (FRN) extracted from a time-estimation task as the observer
Average positive mood score derived from 8-item Mood Measure Scale
Average negative mood score derived from 8-item Mood Measure Scale
Summary score from the Perceived Group Reinforcement Scale which indicates the level of bonding in the context of group social interaction.
For how many years have the subject known the friend that they came in with.
Number of binge drinking days assessed via transdermal biosensor during the ambulatory assessment period
Circular correlation coefficient (CCorr) extracted from a video watching task while EEG were acquired
